description: Enables the default permissions. remote.urls allowlists the loopback origin the packaged app loads (release serves the bundled Next server over http://127.0.0.1:<ephemeral-port> via WebviewUrl::External in lib.rs). Tauri v2 does not apply capability permissions to remote/external origins unless allowlisted, so without this every core:window command (minimize/toggle_maximize/close) is ACL-denied in the installed app. Loopback-only; port wildcarded because it is chosen at runtime.
